regions.title: Tahoe
regions.text: Kirkwood leads with 43" over the six days, with the big day Wednesday at 26". A Winter Storm Warning runs Friday through Saturday with strong southwest wind and gusts to 52 mph. Palisades (37") and Sugar Bowl (36") follow close behind.

regions.title: Eastern Sierra
regions.text: Mammoth expects 30", with 19" on Wednesday. Friday brings heavy snow, a Winter Storm Warning through Saturday, and gusts up to 70 mph with wind chill near 5. The NWS is calling for more, 27" to 48" from Friday through Wednesday night.

regions.title: Cascades
regions.text: Stevens Pass tops out at 12", with the most on Wednesday at 4". Much of the early week is rain at lower elevations and mixed rain and snow, so expect soft, wet snow. Crystal Mountain (11") and Mt. Bachelor (9") are similar, and Mt. Bachelor's best day is Friday at 4".

regions.title: Wasatch
regions.text: Snowbird, Alta and Brighton each forecast 10", with 7" on Tuesday. Snow is likely Friday afternoon and through Saturday, with rain mixing in Tuesday morning. The NWS is calling for more, 18" to 35" at Snowbird and 22" to 44" at Alta from Friday night through Wednesday night.

regions.title: Coast Mountains
regions.text: Whistler forecasts 15", with the best day Saturday at 6". Expect periods of rain Saturday and Sunday, so the snow will be heavy and wet. Cypress Mountain sees only 3" of snow, mostly with showers and rain, and strong wind near the water.

regions.title: Northern Rockies
regions.text: Sun Valley forecasts 10", with 3" on Friday and mostly light snow next week. Big Sky expects 6" on Tuesday, with light snow through midweek. Grand Targhee sees 5", 4" of it on Tuesday.

regions.title: Southern Rockies
regions.text: Wolf Creek forecasts 7" with snow showers and gusty southwest wind Tuesday and Wednesday, gusts up to 55 mph. The NWS is calling for more, 20" to 39" from Friday night through Wednesday. Taos forecasts 4", and the NWS is calling for more, 10" to 20" through Tuesday night.

regions.title: Central Rockies
regions.text: Telluride forecasts 7", with the best day Saturday at 3". Expect snow showers with a slight chance of thunderstorms on Saturday and Tuesday. The NWS is calling for more, 8" to 19" from Friday night through Wednesday. Steamboat (4") and Crested Butte (3") are lighter.
